summary.text: Dwight Kiefert is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 24 (home city listed as Valley City), serving since 2013 per the legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Kiefert lists an occupation of Farmer; Agribusiness.
It lists education as Valley City High School.
Family is listed as: Married (Robbin); 3 children.
For the 2025 regular session, the page lists Kiefert's standing committee assignments as Agriculture and Human Services.
